title: Weather Forecasts
description: Listen to the short weather forecasts and choose the right weather.

thumbnail.alt: A sun and a cloud with rain on a map
thumbnail.prompt: A sun and a cloud with rain on a map aspect ratio 16:10

questions.prompt: Listen to the forecast. What should you take with you?

media.text: Good morning! It's going to be a wet and windy day today. Don't forget your umbrella when you leave the house.

questions.explanation: The weather is wet and windy, so you need an umbrella.

questions.prompt: Listen to the forecast. What is the weather like?

media.text: Welcome to the weekend! We have clear blue skies and the temperature will reach 86 degrees.

questions.explanation: Clear blue skies and 86 degrees (30 °C) means it is sunny and hot.

questions.prompt: Listen to the forecast. Is it a good day to go to the beach?

media.text: It will be mostly cloudy today with a chance of thunderstorms in the afternoon. Stay indoors if you hear thunder.

options.text: Yes, but only in the morning.

questions.explanation: There is a chance of thunderstorms, so it is not a good day for the beach.

questions.prompt: Listen to the forecast. What happens at night?

media.text: Today will be nice and warm, but temperatures will drop below freezing tonight, so cover your plants.

questions.explanation: Temperatures will drop below freezing, which means it gets very cold.

questions.prompt: Listen to the forecast. What is the problem for drivers?

media.text: Drivers, please be careful this morning. There is thick fog on the roads and visibility is very low.

options.text: The roads are covered in ice.

questions.explanation: Thick fog makes visibility low, so drivers cannot see well.

questions.prompt: Listen to the forecast. What will the weather be like tomorrow?

media.text: The rain will continue today and tonight, but it will clear up by tomorrow morning for a beautiful Sunday.

questions.explanation: It will clear up by tomorrow morning, meaning the rain stops and it is nice.

questions.prompt: Listen to the forecast. Should you wear a jacket?

media.text: It's quite chilly out there today with a strong breeze from the north. You'll definitely want a warm coat.

options.text: Yes, because it is cold and windy.

questions.explanation: "Chilly" means cold, and you will want a warm coat.

questions.prompt: Listen to the forecast. What is a blizzard?

media.text: A severe blizzard warning is in effect. Expect heavy snow and very strong winds all night.

questions.explanation: A blizzard involves heavy snow and strong winds.
